mapper.sql: CASE WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.insured_name ELSE si.name END AS insuredName, CASE WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.insured_phone ELSE si.phone END AS insuredPhone

SELECT sr.id, sr.name, sr.phone, sr.case_title, sr.case_description, sr.visit_date, sr.status, sr.process_remark, sr.create_time, sr.update_time, NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_name), '') AS reporter_name, NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_phone), '') AS reporter_phone, pr.decision AS review_decision, pr.payout_amount, pr.payment_confirmed_at, sp.policy_no, sp.product_name, FROM service_record sr LEFT JOIN service_policy sp ON sp.id = sr.policy_id LEFT JOIN service_insured si ON si.id = sr.insured_id LEFT JOIN case_payment_review pr ON pr.case_id = sr.id

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_policy p WHERE p.id = sr.policy_id AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{query.policyNo}), LOWER(p.policy_no)) > 0)
AND sr.status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_payment_review pending_review WHERE pending_review.case_id = sr.id)

mapper.select: ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC, sr.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}
ORDER BY sr.create_time DESC, sr.id DESC

SELECT sr.id, sr.case_title, NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_name), '') AS reporter_name, sr.name AS patient_name, sp.policy_no, pr.payout_amount, pr.payment_confirmed_by, pr.payment_confirmed_at, sr.process_remark
ORDER BY pr.payment_confirmed_at DESC, sr.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
/* ==================== 案件基本信息 ==================== */
sr.id AS id,
sr.name AS name,
sr.phone AS phone,
sr.case_title AS caseTitle,
sr.visit_date AS visitDate,
sr.case_description AS caseDescription,
sr.status AS status,
sr.create_time AS createTime,
sr.update_time AS updateTime,
sr.process_remark AS processRemark, pr.decision AS reviewDecision, pr.payout_amount AS payoutAmount, pr.review_remark AS reviewRemark, pr.reviewer_phone AS reviewerPhone, pr.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, pr.payment_confirmed_by AS paymentConfirmedBy, pr.payment_confirmed_at AS paymentConfirmedAt,
/* ==================== 报案人 ==================== */
NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_name), '') AS reporterName,
NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_phone), '') AS reporterPhone,
NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_id_type), '') AS reporterIdType,
NULLIF(TRIM(sr.reporter_id_no), '') AS reporterIdNo,
/* ==================== 被保险人 ==================== */
si.id AS insuredId,
,
CASE WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.insured_id_type ELSE si.id_type END AS insuredIdType,
CASE WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL THEN sp.insured_id_no ELSE si.id_no END AS insuredIdNo,
si.gender AS insuredGender,
si.birthday AS insuredBirthday,
/* ==================== 保单 ==================== */
sp.id AS policyId,
sp.policy_no AS policyNo,
sp.product_name AS productName, sp.insurer_name AS insurerName,
sp.applicant_name AS applicantName,
sp.applicant_id_type AS applicantIdType,
sp.applicant_id_no AS applicantIdNo,
sp.applicant_phone AS applicantPhone,
sp.insured_name AS policyInsuredName,
sp.insured_id_type AS policyInsuredIdType,
sp.insured_id_no AS policyInsuredIdNo,
sp.insured_phone AS policyInsuredPhone,
sp.premium AS premium,
sp.status AS policyStatus,
sp.start_date AS policyStartDate,
sp.end_date AS policyEndDate
FROM service_record sr
/* 被保险人 */ LEFT JOIN service_insured si ON sr.insured_id = si.id
/* 保单 */ LEFT JOIN service_policy sp ON sr.policy_id = sp.id LEFT JOIN case_payment_review pr ON pr.case_id = sr.id
WHERE sr.id = #{id}
LIMIT 1
